mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust consumer demand for residential construction, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% indicates labor market deterioration, which typically triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a supply shock, which typically disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5% signals robust consumer demand, which typically boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1.5% monthly growth), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slowing employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 6.0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (as indicated by GDP above 15900 billion dollars), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and anticipation of policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 > 15900), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
